## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that solves it.

## Validation

List the commands or checks you ran and their results.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and avoids unrelated refactoring.
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] Behavior changes include appropriate tests or a reason tests are not applicable.
- [ ] Lint, type-check, test, and build commands that apply have passed.
- [ ] No secrets, local environment files, or private data are included.
